_description.summary: Text and strings: ASCII conversion, symbols, text formatting (bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, obfuscated, color), string building (empty, space, comma, newline), chat reading and prefix filters, glyph split and combine, iota-to-string and pattern-to-string conversions, sign and lectern reading.
use_cases: Converting between strings, iotas and patterns

complexhex:ascii.d:
Swaps between a string of a *single character* and an integer representing that character.
Uses the UTF-16 character map.

complexhex:new_symbol.d: Creates a new symbol with the given (single character) label

hexpose:create_text.d: Takes an iota and returns a text iota representing it. If taking a text iota, strips all the styles of it.

hexpose:text_bold.d: Takes a text iota and sets whether it is **bold**.

hexpose:text_italics.d: Takes a text iota and sets whether it is in *italics*.

hexpose:text_underline.d: Takes a text iota and sets whether it is __underlined__.

hexpose:text_strikethrough.d: Takes a text iota and sets whether it has been ~~struck through~~.

hexpose:text_obfuscated.d: Takes a text iota and sets whether it is obfusca||ted||.

moreiotas:string/empty.d: Add an empty string to the stack, useful for combining with other strings.

moreiotas:string/space.d: Add a blank space string to the stack, useful for combining with other strings.

moreiotas:string/comma.d: Add a comma string to the stack, useful for combining with other strings.

moreiotas:string/newline.d: Add a string to the stack representing a break between lines, useful for combining with other strings.

moreiotas:string/block/get.d: Removes a vector from the stack. If that vector is pointing at a sign or lectern, it returns that sign or lectern's text to the stack. Otherwise, it returns null.

moreiotas:string/chat/caster.d: Adds the last message the caster sent to the stack as a string.

moreiotas:string/chat/all.d: Adds the last message anyone sent to the stack as a string.

moreiotas:string/chat/prefix/get.d: Returns the last string you passed to Sifter's Gambit.

moreiotas:string/chat/prefix/set.d: Accepts a string; All future chat messages starting with that string won't be seen by others, and only messages prefixed with that string can be read by Whisper Reflection.

moreiotas:string/iota.d: Converts the iota on top of the stack into a string.

moreiotas:string/action.d: Converts the pattern on top of the stack into the string for that pattern's name. If there is no action associated with that pattern, or if the associated pattern is a Great Spell, it returns null.

moreiotas:string/name/get.d: Takes an entity and returns that entity's name. If it is an item entity, return the item's name. | Takes a Ship and returns that Ship's slug.

moreiotas:string/name/set.d: Takes a string and an entity, and sets that entities name to the given string. If the entity is an item entity, also set the item's name. Costs a hundredth of an Amethyst Dust.

moreiotas:string/split.d: Removes the top two strings from the stack and splits the first string, using the second string as the delimiter and returning as a list.

moreiotas:string/parse.d: Removes a string from the top of the stack and returns the number that string parses as (or null if it doesn't parse).

moreiotas:string/case.d: Removes a string and a bool or null. If it was true, return the string in upper case. If false, lowercase. If null, toggle each character's case.

overevaluate:athena_log.d: Pushes the last mishap caught by Athena's Gambit as *text* if the appropriate powers are active in this world.
